summary.text: Veronica Klinefelt is a Democratic state senator from Michigan State Senate District 11 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served on the Macomb County Board of Commissioners.

paragraphs.text: Veronica Klinefelt has served on the Macomb County Board of Commissioners, as president of the Michigan Association of Counties, and on the National Association of Counties Board of Directors.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she served as a Macomb County commissioner for 10 years, an Eastpointe city councilwoman for 8 years and an East Detroit school board member for 6 years, and that she has lived in Macomb County for more than 30 years.
In the Senate, Klinefelt's 2025 and 2026 assignments include the Appropriations Committee, and she chairs the Veterans and Emergency Services Committee and the Local Government Committee.
She is also majority vice chair of the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee and sits on the Health Policy and Human Services Committee.

In her 2026 survey, Klinefelt listed the affordability and accessibility of health care, child care and homeownership, along with investment in school districts and local infrastructure, as her key messages.
